description: Protects the domain's e-mail from spoofing: merges the domain's mail senders into its SPF record and delegates its DMARC policy by CNAME to a record Selan keeps in its own zone (dmarc.selan.ai), so the policy can later move from monitoring to quarantine without another change to the domain's DNS.
variableDescription: %spfRules%: SPF mechanisms of the domain's mail provider(s) for the SPFM merge, without the leading "v=spf1" and the final "all" (e.g. include:_spf.google.com); %dmarcid%: the label Selan assigns to this domain under dmarc.selan.ai (e.g. example-com)
